canonical_data: a per-run output directory holding the MAP-Elites program archive, island populations, and numbered checkpoints on the user's own filesystem
strengths: Island-based MAP-Elites archive with cascade evaluation and an artifact side-channel feeds evaluator error output back into the next generation's prompt
Runs fully local-first: host or Docker execution, local model backends, and a filesystem-only checkpoint archive with no mandatory cloud dependency
Ships a visualizer over the checkpoint archive and documents a worked example gallery with per-example evaluators
weaknesses: The loop has no approval gate or pause point once started; control is exercised only through the evaluator and config set before a run begins

Headline claims ("most advanced open-source evolutionary coding agent," "2-3x speedups," "state-of-the-art circle packing") are each tied to one worked example rather than an independently reproduced benchmark
Tool surface is narrow: no MCP integration and no browser, shell, or multi-agent coordination capability, only LLM mutation plus a caller-supplied evaluator
why_it_matters: An open, self-hostable implementation of the AlphaEvolve evolutionary-coding pattern, usable as a library or CLI to drive LLM-mutated program search against a user's own evaluator rather than a closed research demo.
